title: discovery: trusts peer-supplied owner_user_id — outbound delivery redirection
description:
Attack: malicious tailnet node M serves /.well-known/jmap with owner_user_id = alice-id. upsert_discovered_contact runs ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE SET peer_mailbox_host = M_host. Outbound delivery for alice-id now goes to M instead of Alice's real kithd — outbound message interception.

Fix: in run_discovery_round, each PeerNode from /status already has a WhoIs-verified user_id. After probe_peer() returns a PeerSession, compare session.owner_user_id against peer.user_id (from LocalAPI /status). If they diverge, log a warning and skip the upsert. No extra WhoIs call needed — /status user_id is already authoritative.

Requires passing peer.user_id through the JoinSet task tuple: change (dns_name, session) to (dns_name, peer_user_id, session).
